# Khaya La Manzi Guest Lodge

> Seaside B&B and self-catering guest lodge in Hibberdene on the KwaZulu-Natal South Coast, South Africa. Air-conditioned thatched rooms, three sea-facing self-catering apartments and a three-bedroom lodge with 180° Indian Ocean views, pool, braais, games room and secure parking. 2.5 km off the N2, about an hour south of Durban.

- Address: 158 Riviera Highway, Hibberdene, KwaZulu-Natal, 4220, South Africa (GPS -30.5749, 30.5726)
- Cell and WhatsApp: 083 300 4725 (+27833004725)
- Email: bookings@khayalamanzi.co.za
- Booking: online via NightsBridge, or enquire by WhatsApp or email. Rates on request; minimum stays apply.
- Key collection 14:00 to 17:00; check-out 10:00. No pets. 50% deposit confirms a booking.

## Apartments
- [Elephant](https://khayalamanzi.co.za/elephant.html): Two-bedroom sea-facing apartment with deck, ground floor, sleeps 4. Bedroom 1: queen bed. Bedroom 2: king bed. Shower and separate toilet. TV lounge, fully equipped kitchen, breakfast nook and dining room. Large sea-facing deck with table, chairs and braai.
- [Seahorse](https://khayalamanzi.co.za/seahorse.html): One-bedroom sea-facing apartment with deck, ground floor, sleeps 2. King bed with en-suite bathroom (shower over bath). Fully equipped kitchenette with breakfast nook. Dining table for two. Sea-facing deck with table, chairs and braai.
- [Whale](https://khayalamanzi.co.za/whale.html): One-bedroom sea-facing apartment, upstairs, sleeps 2. King bed (splits into two singles). En-suite bathroom with bath. Fully fitted kitchenette and breakfast nook. Dining table for two.

## Rooms
- The Lodge: Three-bedroom sea-facing thatched lodge, sleeps 6. The whole-house option for groups and family get-togethers: three en-suite bedrooms under thatch, each with its own door onto the deck, plus a full kitchen, dining room, bar lounge and TV lounge.
- Bachelor rooms 1 to 3: Air-conditioned suites, sleeps 2, or 3 in rooms 1 and 2. Thatched, air-conditioned suites with a king bed that splits into two singles, a kitchenette and a sliding door onto the private courtyard.
- Family rooms 4 and 5: Two-room family units with loft, sleeps 4 (unit 4) or 6 (unit 5). Two-room units with a loft for the kids, a kitchenette and their own patio with a braai.

## Distances
- Hibberdene main beach: walking distance
- N2 highway: 2.5 km
- Pumula Beach Hotel: 6 km
- Umzumbe: 10 km
- Oribi Gorge: 60 km
- Wild Coast Sun: 85 km
- Durban: 96 km, about 1 hour
- uShaka Marine World: 100 km
- King Shaka International Airport: 130 km
- Pietermaritzburg: 166 km, 1 h 40

## Questions
- **Where is Khaya La Manzi?** 158 Riviera Highway, Hibberdene, KwaZulu-Natal, 4220. 2.5 km off the N2 on the KZN South Coast, about an hour south of Durban.
- **Is Khaya La Manzi a B&B or self-catering?** Both. Bachelor and family rooms run B&B style (dinner by arrangement), and there are three self-catering sea-facing apartments plus a three-bedroom self-catering lodge.
- **Do the rooms have sea views?** The lodge looks out over the Indian Ocean with 180° views. Elephant, Seahorse, Whale and the Lodge are sea-facing.
- **Is Khaya La Manzi close to the beach?** Yes. Hibberdene's lifeguard-patrolled main beach is a short walk downhill, next to the river lagoon.
- **Which unit suits a family?** Family unit 5 sleeps 6, and Family unit 4 and Elephant sleep 4. For a bigger group, book the three-bedroom Lodge, which sleeps 6.
- **Are the rooms air-conditioned?** Yes. The bachelor and family rooms and all the self-catering apartments are air-conditioned.
- **Is there TV?** Each unit has a TV with SABC channels and a DStv connection: bring your own decoder and smart card.
- **What are the rates?** Rates depend on season and length of stay. See live rates and availability on the Book online page, or ask for a quote.
- **Is there a swimming pool?** Yes, with decks and a braai area. The pool is not fenced or netted, so children must be supervised by an adult at all times.
- **Is there secure parking?** Yes, on site behind a remote-controlled gate. Please close the gate behind you for everyone's security.
- **Is there something for the kids to do?** The games room has pool, table tennis and board games. It is open until 9 pm and children must be supervised.
- **Is there a gym?** Yes, a small gym for guests.
- **What are check-in and check-out times?** Key collection is between 14:00 and 17:00. Units must be vacated by 10:00 on the day of departure. Late key collection is by arrangement, for a fee.
- **How do I pay?** A 50% non-refundable deposit confirms your booking. Out of season the balance is due 5 working days before arrival; in season, 3 weeks before.
- **Are pets allowed?** No. Pets are not allowed on the property.
- **How do I get to Khaya La Manzi from Durban?** Take the N2 south and the Hibberdene R102 exit. Turn left at the bottom of the ramp, go about 2 km, turn right into David Drive and follow the Khaya La Manzi signs.
